hero.title: Actually learn Italian, one conversation at a time.
hero.subtitle: Tailored 1-on-1 lessons for foreigners: from everyday survival to CILS and CELI exam prep. No dusty textbooks, just living language.

method.title: How it works
method.step1Body: A free 20-minute call to understand your level, schedule and why you need Italian.
method.step2Body: Materials, exercises and conversations tailored to you. No one-size-fits-all syllabus.
method.step3Body: Regular lessons, continuous feedback and targeted corrections. You speak from day one.

courses.title: What we can do together
courses.conversationBody: Unlock your speaking and lose the fear of mistakes with real dialogue.
courses.examBody: Strategies, mock exams and everything you need to pass the certification.
courses.grammarBody: Subjunctive, prepositions, verb tenses: explained so they stick.
courses.businessBody: Emails, meetings and professional vocabulary for living or working in Italy.

about.title: Hi, I'm Gan!
about.body: I've been teaching Italian to foreigners for years, online and in person. I believe you learn a language by using it, not memorising it. My lessons are relaxed but serious: we have fun and you make real progress. I believe learning a language means opening new doors, creating opportunities and feeling confident communicating with the world. That's why I'll guide you step by step with energy, passion and care, turning learning into an engaging and rewarding experience.

reviews.title: What students say
reviews.r1: I finally stopped being afraid to speak. Gan makes it all natural.
reviews.r2: I passed CILS B2 on the first try. Flawless preparation.
reviews.r3: The most enjoyable hour of my week. I learn without even noticing.

booking.title: Book your lesson
booking.subtitle: Choose a time that works for you. The first intro call is free.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What language are the lessons in?
faq.a1: In Italian from the start, but I can explain in English or Albanian when needed.
faq.a2: Usually 60 minutes, but we can agree on 30 or 90 minutes.
faq.a3: For now via bank transfer or PayPal after booking. Online payment is coming soon.
faq.a4: Yes, up to 24 hours before the lesson at no cost.
